senses.gloss: to separate something into parts or groups

senses.gloss: to cause disagreement or difference between people
senses.example: The proposal divided the committee into two groups.

translations.th_TH: ทำให้แตกแยก

example_translations.zh_TW: 這項提案使委員會分成了兩派。
example_translations.ja_JP: その提案は委員会を二つのグループに分裂させた。

example_translations.vi_VN: Đề xuất đó đã chia ủy ban thành hai nhóm.
example_translations.th_TH: ข้อเสนอนั้นทำให้คณะกรรมการแบ่งออกเป็นสองฝ่าย

definition_translations.zh_TW: 造成不同人之間的分歧或差異
definition_translations.ja_JP: 人々の間に意見の対立や違いを生じさせる

senses.gloss: to calculate how many times one number fits into another
